messages:
amy (recruiter): heads-up — after last night's HR role-sync a bunch of interviewers lost access to scorecards (404) and their scorecard weightings reset to default. noticed while prepping panels for tomorrow morning. :grimacing:

maria (people-ops): ugh. do we have a sync job id or sample interviewer ids?

amy (recruiter): sync id `hr-sync-2026-05-04-01`. affected interviewers: I-321, I-322, I-341, I-390.

raj (eng): looking. the sync wrote `roles` in bulk and the writer service had a mapping change: `weights` field was omitted when role metadata is absent. that would reset scorecard weights and possibly break signed URLs if the form pointer isn't copied.

oliver (trainer): mitigation: I can reapply saved weight profiles and reissue scorecard links for the four interviewers. quick ask: can eng gate the next sync while we run a backfill?

sync-bot: event hr-sync-2026-05-04-01 completed at 2026-05-04T01:12:05Z, records_changed=1145, service=hr-sync-v3

raj (eng): pausing subsequent scheduled syncs now. i'll run a one-off backfill to copy `scorecard_meta` from previous snapshots for affected ids. will add a validation to skip writes if `weights` would be nulled.

amy (recruiter): thanks — blocking two panel leads tomorrow otherwise. can oliver run the restore immediately and i'll notify hiring managers?

oliver (trainer): running restore for I-321,I-322,I-341,I-390 now: command `./tools/restore_weights --ids I-321,I-322,I-341,I-390`. will post results in ~5m.

oliver (trainer): done — restored previous weights and reissued scorecard links. tested access as recruiter and interviewer for all four.

raj (eng): backfill completed and guard added to sync writer. opened PR https://github.com/redwood/hr-sync/pull/92 (includes unit test). will reopen scheduler after a quick smoke run.

maria (people-ops): thanks team. i'll send a note to hiring managers and add a runbook entry: "after HR sync, verify scorecard links + weights for active interviewers". scheduling a 10m postmortem later today.

amy (recruiter): verified with hiring managers — panels OK now. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
